name: Adah
description: Woman living at the time before the Flood

points: “And Lamech took unto him two wives”: the first time you read about polygamy is here, in Cain’s kids. “The name of the one was Adah, and the name of the other Zillah.”

note.label: Good And Evil | Generation To Generation: From Beginning To End

points: “And Lamech took unto him two wives”. Keep that name Lamech in mind: Enoch had Lamech, on Cain’s line. These are Cainites, the wicked. The name of the one was Adah, wife one; the name of the other Zillah, wife two.

note.label: Good And Evil | Generation To Generation: From Beginning To End

points: Lamech took unto him two wives: this is the first time you read about multiple wives, in Genesis 4:19. Adah bare Jabal, the father of such as dwell in tents and have cattle: dealing with pricing and unrighteousness. His brother Jubal was the father of all such as handle the harp and organ: do you think it was holy music? It was songs about murder, drugs, debauchery, and adultery. That is what was going on in this city. Zillah bare Tubalcain, an instructer of every artificer in brass and iron: weapons. This man was making all kinds of weapons.

“And Adah bare Jabal: he was the father of such as dwell in tents, and of such as have cattle.” The meaning of Jabal in Hebrew, they say, is water course, conduit or stream: to stream from, to flow. Jabal and Jubal mean the same thing. That name has various confusing meanings, which is very weird: his children had confusing names, and they built a damn city in a land of confusion, Babel. That’s not a coincidence at all.
